description: Finds bus stops, stations and the places around them by name, in one city or in every city. Accepts common English spellings of Pakistani place names, such as Faizabad or Faiz Abad. Returns the place_id and city each other tool needs. When nothing matches in a city, it lists the stops in that city served by the most routes.

city.description: Search one city network. Leave out to search every city.

query.description: Place name in English letters, such as Liberty Chowk or Saddar.

name: find_places
title: Find places
